visual_grammar_references: Ghiyaats Muhammad — Job Listing Dashboard (master list -> persistent detail)
Outcrowd — Sync CRM (restrained controls, density, one meaningful accent)
Ronas IT — CRM Dashboard Web UI (prolonged-use neutral data workspace)
Stephanie Howden — Financial Portfolio Management (executive-grade information hierarchy)
rejected_references: AI job dashboard / ATS visual pattern: match %, card galleries, apply-first mechanics

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Executives understand Briefing as a temporal decision queue and Opportunities as the durable opportunity workspace, with Shortlist explicitly available inside Opportunities.
success_evidence: user does not confuse Briefing with the opportunity catalog
user reaches the relevant opportunity from a briefing item without searching again
user finds Shortlist immediately inside Opportunities
user compares shortlisted roles through list + detail inspection without forced pagination

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Contextual investigation actions and Open pursuit workspace represent meaningfully different levels of commitment while mapping to canonical Explore and Pursue actions.
success_evidence: user describes Investigate authority & pay, Investigate scope & reporting, or Prepare for call as bounded work to reduce uncertainty or prepare
user understands Open pursuit workspace as moving the opportunity into active work
Open pursuit workspace is not confused with Apply, outreach, or any external submission

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured opportunity judgement provides more executive value than a fit percentage.
success_evidence: user notices trajectory, scope, access and uncertainty trade-offs
user can identify at least one open question before pursuing
user does not ask for a single percentage as the only explanation

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Route-to-company guidance is perceived as actionable differentiation beyond direct apply.
success_evidence: user understands relationship fact vs route recommendation
recommended route feels credible
user expects outreach to remain manual/explicit

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Binding a mandate fragment to career evidence feels useful rather than bureaucratic.
success_evidence: user can select relevant evidence without explanation
user understands reuse in positioning/resume/interview
user does not think binding independently verifies the claim

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit side-by-side comparison helps executives resolve trade-offs faster than mentally comparing separate opportunity details.
success_evidence: user selects two or more shortlisted opportunities for comparison without prompting
user uses named dimensions such as trajectory, scope, route and unknowns rather than asking for one aggregate score
comparison changes or sharpens at least one stated preference or next action

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Once an opportunity is active, the pursuit workspace makes the next move and current decision context obvious without forcing the executive through multiple modules.
success_evidence: user can state the next move within 30 seconds of entering the workspace
user can identify the current picture, highest-impact unknown and route without opening multiple areas
user understands the workspace as a private working file rather than an application submission screen

p0_hypotheses.hypothesis: Stable workspace navigation with stage-aware composition remains understandable as the opportunity progresses through recruiter conversation, selection, final/reference and offer contexts.
success_evidence: user recognizes what changed in the selected stage scenario without relearning navigation
the stage-specific next move feels appropriate to the current process context
irrelevant future modules such as Offer do not dominate earlier stages
